title: Plitzi team
description: Who works this project's runs of several agents (plitzi run). Checked by the CLI too: plitzi run team check.

lead.description: The lead, the manager: it plans with you, approves what a spike proposes, answers, decides what a tester escalates and finishes. One: the testers review.

model.description: The harness's name for the model — or one a quality level: { "standard": "claude-sonnet-5-5", "high": "claude-opus-5-5" }

effort.description: How hard they think — Claude Code's --effort, Codex's reasoning effort; left out, the harness's own

name.description: What its agents are called: dev is dev-1, dev-2…

roles.description: developer, designer, reviewer, tester, scout, writer — or a role of your own

count.description: How many of it; one when left out

min.description: How many start with the run, from 0 to its count: the rest are on demand — started when work waits for them, stopped once none is left

model.description: The harness's name for the model — or one a quality level: { "standard": "claude-sonnet-5-5", "high": "claude-opus-5-5" }

effort.description: How hard it thinks — Claude Code's --effort, Codex's reasoning effort; left out, the harness's own

session.description: When its agents are started again with a fresh context, always between two pieces of work (a task completed, a review decided), never in one: task (the default) after each one, context once its context passes options.freshContextAt, keep never

resumeSession.description: Started again after it died with a task in hand, an agent resumes its own session (Claude Code's --resume) — what it knew and had not written yet kept — unless the session is too large to read again for less than starting over

skill.description: A markdown file of the project its agents read first — what a role of your own does: .claude/skills/accessibility/SKILL.md

options.description: How the team works, beside who is in it.

designReview.description: How closely a designer reviews another task's UI: light (its pages, 1440 and 390, the default scheme), standard (both schemes and widths, its sections against the reference — the default), high (every page that reads its files, against the run before it too). A review costs what it looks at.

startGraceMinutes.description: How long an agent just started may say nothing before the tasks it holds read 'no signal' and it reads as not running: 3 when not said

freshContextAt.description: The context, in tokens, past which an agent of "session": "context" is started again with a fresh one, between two pieces of work: 250000 when not said

launch.description: The harness the CLI starts the agents in by itself: run watch --until lead starts each agent the run asks for instead of waking the lead to. Left out, the lead starts them.

about.description: What the fields and roles mean, the CLI's: written fresh, never read
